question:
The volume of a metallic cylindrical pipe is 7480 cm3. If its length is 1.4 m and its external radius is 9 cm, then its thickness (given \(\pi\) = 22/7) is:

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 1 cm

Let internal radius = x

Volume of cylinder = \(\pi\)r2h

\(\frac{22}{7}\) × 1.4 × 100 (92 - x2) = 7480

92 - x2= 17

x = 8 cm

Thickness = 9 – 8 = 1 cm

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 1 सेमी है।

आंतरिक त्रिज्‍या मान लें = x

सिलेंडर का आयतन  = \(\pi\)r2h

 \(\frac{22}{7}\)×1.4 ×100 (92 - x2) = 7480

92 - x2= 17

x = 8 सेमी

मोटाई = 9 – 8 = 1 सेमी

question:
The length of a metallic pipe is 7.56 m. Its external and internal radii are 2.5 cm and 1.5 cm, respectively. If 1 cm3 of the metal weight 7.5 g, then the weight of the pipe is: (Take \(\pi\) = 22/7)

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:

= \(\frac{22}{7} × 756 × 1 × 4 × 7.5 × \frac{1}{1000} = 71.28\)kg

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 71.28 किग्रा है।

question:
A cylindrical road roller made of metal is one meter long. Its inner radius is 27 cm and the thickness of the metal sheet rolled into it is 9 cm. What is the weight of the roller, if 1 cm3 of the metal weight 8 gm?.

(CGL 2018 Pre)
options:
441 kg

442.4 kg

449 kg

453.6 kg
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 453.6 kg

Volume of cylinder = \(\pi\)r2h

Volume of hollow cylinder = \(\pi\) × height × [Outer radius]2 - [inner radius)2]

= \(\pi\) × 100 × [(27 + 9)2 - (27)2] = \(\pi\) × 100 × 9 × 63

Weight = Volume × density

= \(\pi\) × 100 × 9 × 63 × 8 gm

= 453600\(\pi\) gm = 453.6\(\pi\) kg
question_hi:
धातु से बना एक बेलनाकार रोड रोलर एक मीटर लंबा है। इसकी आंतरिक त्रिज्या 27 सेमी. है और धातु की शीट की मोटाई 9 सेमी. है। रोलर का वजन कितना है, यदि 1 सेमी.3 धातु का वजन 8 ग्राम है?

(CGL 2018 Pre)
options_hi:
441 किग्रा

442.4 किग्रा

449 किग्रा

453.6 किग्रा
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 453.6 किग्रा है।

सिलेंडर का आयतन = \(\pi\)r2h

खोखले सिलेंडर का आयतन = \(\pi\) × ऊँचाई × [बाहरी त्रिज्‍या]2 - [आंतरिक त्रिज्‍या)2]

= \(\pi\) × 100 × [(27 + 9)2 - (27)2] = \(\pi\) × 100 × 9 × 63

भार = आयतन × घनत्‍व

= \(\pi\) × 100 × 9 × 63 × 8 ग्राम.

= 453600\(\pi\) ग्राम. = 453.6\(\pi\) किग्रा.

question:
The curved surface area and the volume of a cylinder are 264 cm2 and 924 cm3, respectively. What is the ratio of its radius to height? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) )

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 7:6

Curved surface area (C.S.A) = 2 \(\pi ×\) radius × height

Volume of cylinder =  \(\pi ×\) (radius)2 × height

\(\frac{C.S.A}{Vol.} = \frac{2}{r}\)

\(\frac{2rh}{r^2h} = \frac{264}{924} \) ⇒ r = 7

C.S.A = 2  × \(\pi\)  × 7  × h = 264

h = 6

r : h = 7:6
question_hi:
एक बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल और आयतन क्रमशः 264 सेमी.2 और 924 सेमी.3 है। इसकी त्रिज्या और ऊँचाई का अनुपात क्या है? (\(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) लें)

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 7:6 है।

वक्र पृष्‍ठीय क्षेत्रफल (C.S.A) =  2 \(\pi ×\) त्रिज्‍या × ऊँचाई

सिलेंडर का 2 \(\pi ×\)आयतन =\(\pi ×\) (त्रिज्‍या)2 × ऊँचाई

 \(\frac{C.S.A}{Vol.} = \frac{2}{r}\)

\(\frac{2rh}{r^2h} = \frac{264}{924} \) ⇒ r = 7

C.S.A =   2  × \(\pi\)  × 7  × h = 264

h = 6

r : h = 7 : 6

question:
A solid metallic sphere of radius 15 cm is melted and recast into spherical balls of radius 3 cm each. What is the ratio of the surface area of the original sphere and the sum of the surface areas of all the balls?

(CGL MAINS 2018)

number of small spheres(n) = 125

surface area of original sphere = 4πR2

= 4 (15) = 900

surface area of all the balls = n × 4πr2

= (125) × 4 × π(3)2 = 125 × 36π

original ball : All balls

900π : 125×36π

question_hi:

सभी गेंदों का पृष्‍ठीय क्षेत्रफल = n × 4πr2

= (125) × 4 × π(3)2 = 125 × 36π

900π : 125×36π

1 : 5

question:
A spherical metallic shell with 6 cm external radius weighs 6688 g. What is the thickness of the shell if the density of metal is 10.5 g per cm? (Take π = \(22 \over 7\) )

(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 2 cm

Volume of Sphere = \(\frac{6688}{10.5}\)

Volume of spherical metallic shell =\(\frac{4}{3}\) π(R3 – r3)

= \(\frac{4}{3}\)\(\frac{22}{7}\)(63 - r3) 

= 63 - r3 = 152

= r3 = 216 - 152

= r3 = 64

r = 4

Thickness = 6 – 4 = 2 cm
